availability_mapping: availability.supported + target in eligible_targets + non-null N domain -> available with verbatim N range + supported compounds; supported=false -> unsupported with frozen reason copy; target without domain -> unsupported TARGET_NOT_PRESENT (selection kept); load failure -> unavailable (retry offered); 2025/malformed -> unavailable with zero requests
compare_request: POST /v2/counterfactuals/compare REFERENCE_VS_PLAN with a single {target_driver_id, kind=PIT_IN_N_LAPS, lap_offset_n=N, requested_compound} built only from the frozen eligible domain + supported set; invalid N/compound rejected locally with no request (never clamped, never rescheduled)
deep_link: workspaceDeepLink(/counterfactuals, state) -> ?race=&frame=&driver=; expert page hydrates race + exact frame + intervention targets via useExpertWorkspaceHydration; the intervention itself stays user-controlled
entry_point: EXPLORE ALTERNATIVE disclosure -> N select (eligible domain only) + compound select (supported only) + RUN COMPARISON (explicit)
framing: every result carries SIMULATED ALTERNATIVE + Simulator-conditional comparison under a controlled intervention; lifecycle statuses rendered faithfully (EXECUTED/INERT/SUPERSEDED/CANCELLED/TERMINAL/INVALID)
guarantees: causal (frame anchor only, never future data)

refusals.MALFORMED_ANCHOR: exact anchor malformed -> unavailable, zero requests
refusals.SEASON_UNSUPPORTED: 2018-2024 firewall incl. any 2025 race -> unavailable, zero requests
